description: This file is a C header file declaring the interface for the Slap Bmc2 Command Object, including function prototypes for creation, removal, object enrollment, initialization, and getter functions related to the SLAP BMC2 component.

methods.name: SlapCreateBmc2Command
methods.description: Creates a new Slap Bmc2 Command object with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoGetSlapObjCallMap
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP object call map for the Bmc2 Command object based on container context.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoGetSlapObjDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP object descriptor for the Bmc2 Command object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Bmc2 Command object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoRemove
methods.description: Removes the Bmc2 Command object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: SlapBmc2ComoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Bmc2 Command object for proper functioning.
